scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0100; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “This week is busy.” and “Next week is free.” are natural short A1 time-reference utterances.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy naturally preserves week as a seven-day time period.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is practiced first with this week and then recombined with next week.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the target responses with familiar non-target time language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A study-calendar conversation gives the pair a concrete reason to compare this week with next week.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner responses are short and use familiar A1 adjective frames.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: week recurs through recognition, guided dialogue, changed-context transfer and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response shifts the time reference from this week to next week without changing the lexical sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities and outcome align on the same bounded time-period sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; learner-experience confidence is intentionally limited.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: Persian copy preserves the selected meaning.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval.
